olevel_requirement: Five (5) credits at SSC or equivalent in English, Mathematics, Chemistry, Agricultural Science or Biology or Home Economics, and any other science subject, preferably Physics.
direct_entry: (i) At least 2 'A' Level passes in Chemistry, Agricultural Science or Biology, Physics or Home Economics. (ii) NCE credit/merit and ND credit in addition to five (5) credit in SSC or equivalents.
